title: MRSIPrep: A Standardized Post-Quantification Framework for Preprocessing Whole-Brain Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopic Imaging
description: MRSIPrep is a BIDS App for preprocessing already-quantified whole-brain magnetic resonance spectroscopic imaging (MRSI) metabolite maps: registration to anatomical/template space, tissue segmentation, partial-volume correction, atlas projection, and automated quality-control reporting.
